Saturday Sociable Ride

Bristol, United Kingdom · Central Bristol · Social

Saturday Sociable Ride is a social group ride in Bristol, United Kingdom. It rolls every Saturday at 10:00 am local time from Castle Park, central Bristol (check the Meetup event).

About the Saturday Sociable Ride group ride

A volunteer-run group for adults that posts sociable rides from central Bristol on quiet roads and cycle paths. It is not competitive, most riders use hybrids, and the group stays together behind the leader. The group has more than 5,500 members.
